title: The Future & What You'd Do - A jövő és a feltételes mód
grammar: review the future (fog, tervez, majd) and the conditional mood

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can talk about the future with fog + infinitive, tervez + infinitive, and majd, and negate the future.
I can use the conditional mood (-nék/-nál/-na...) to make suggestions, give advice, and talk about hypothetical situations with ha.
